adaptations: C Sprite callback expressed as a typed BuiltinSprite override; registered name, BaseClass parent and defaults retained.
Out-of-range Color/Alpha byte casts reject creation instead of an undefined wrap.
FastApproxArea joins the existing CF_NORUNTIME editor-only list.
Spawner strings are value-owned; velocity draws use one unit draw per axis with the linear interval formula.
The rift explosion request is counted and reported as unavailable; the spawn and sound still follow the source order.
Spawner velocity, sound radius and respawn rate are bounded; restore creation rejects.
WeaponStrToInt's unmatched-name Beretta default applies to both editions; matched families that are not integrated still reject.
The zero-count proximity AddInventoryWeapon call is omitted; nonzero counts follow the source (demo refuses, retail slot 10 capped at 10).
FindHealth reproduces the always-empty powerup search; its unreachable path commands fail explicitly.
Base Escape_Hide/Special handlers are no-ops for the Prophet and Fanatic Special2..8, as the original empty virtuals.
A howitzer shell whose shooter is already pending removal unlinks it and attributes the blast to no one.
Prophet Fire keeps primary fire when the target velocity is unavailable (the source reads an uninitialized vector).
MoveObject sweeps ignore an initially overlapped face unless a nonzero move goes deeper into it; triangles are wound toward their plane normal at build.
SniperRiflePU is registered; the sniper rifle weapon is not integrated, so the inventory refuses the offer.

references.purpose: Later LithTech CollideWithWorldModel_Poly: one-sided polygons and contacts whose normal faces along the offset (dot >= 0) are ignored. Corroborates the MoveObject departure policy; not imported and not a 1998 engine trace.
